Version 1
SubGoalCombiner SGC_AND
INITSECTION
PROC_ARCANA_Resonant_Temper_Init();

KBSECTION
//REGION Resonant - Temper table (GENERATED by gen_emotion_alchemy.pl -- do not edit by hand)
PROC
PROC_ARCANA_Resonant_Temper_Init()
AND
DB_ARCANA_Resonant_TemperStep(_Dir, _From, _To)
THEN
NOT DB_ARCANA_Resonant_TemperStep(_Dir, _From, _To);

PROC
PROC_ARCANA_Resonant_Temper_Init()
THEN
DB_ARCANA_Resonant_TemperStep("LEFT", "MOOD_SERENE", "MOOD_INTERESTED");
DB_ARCANA_Resonant_TemperStep("RIGHT", "MOOD_SERENE", "MOOD_ACCEPTING");
DB_ARCANA_Resonant_TemperStep("LEFT", "MOOD_ACCEPTING", "MOOD_SERENE");
DB_ARCANA_Resonant_TemperStep("RIGHT", "MOOD_ACCEPTING", "MOOD_APPREHENSIVE");
DB_ARCANA_Resonant_TemperStep("LEFT", "MOOD_APPREHENSIVE", "MOOD_ACCEPTING");
DB_ARCANA_Resonant_TemperStep("RIGHT", "MOOD_APPREHENSIVE", "MOOD_DISTRACTED");
DB_ARCANA_Resonant_TemperStep("LEFT", "MOOD_DISTRACTED", "MOOD_APPREHENSIVE");
DB_ARCANA_Resonant_TemperStep("RIGHT", "MOOD_DISTRACTED", "MOOD_PENSIVE");
DB_ARCANA_Resonant_TemperStep("LEFT", "MOOD_PENSIVE", "MOOD_DISTRACTED");
DB_ARCANA_Resonant_TemperStep("RIGHT", "MOOD_PENSIVE", "MOOD_BORED");
DB_ARCANA_Resonant_TemperStep("LEFT", "MOOD_BORED", "MOOD_PENSIVE");
DB_ARCANA_Resonant_TemperStep("RIGHT", "MOOD_BORED", "MOOD_ANNOYED");
DB_ARCANA_Resonant_TemperStep("LEFT", "MOOD_ANNOYED", "MOOD_BORED");
DB_ARCANA_Resonant_TemperStep("RIGHT", "MOOD_ANNOYED", "MOOD_INTERESTED");
DB_ARCANA_Resonant_TemperStep("LEFT", "MOOD_INTERESTED", "MOOD_ANNOYED");
DB_ARCANA_Resonant_TemperStep("RIGHT", "MOOD_INTERESTED", "MOOD_SERENE");

IF
SavegameLoaded()
THEN
PROC_ARCANA_Resonant_Temper_Init();
//END_REGION

//REGION Resonant - Temper: the mood turns one step on the wheel and keeps its remaining turns (spec 7.2; R7: it replaces, never reacts)
IF
StatusApplied(_Target, "RESONANT_TEMPER_LEFT_TECH", (CHARACTER)_Resonant, _)
THEN
PROC_ARCANA_Resonant_Temper(_Target, "LEFT", _Resonant);

IF
StatusApplied(_Target, "RESONANT_TEMPER_RIGHT_TECH", (CHARACTER)_Resonant, _)
THEN
PROC_ARCANA_Resonant_Temper(_Target, "RIGHT", _Resonant);

// first collect, then apply: the new mood must not match another step of the same pass
PROC
PROC_ARCANA_Resonant_Temper((GUIDSTRING)_Target, (STRING)_Dir, (CHARACTER)_Resonant)
AND
DB_ARCANA_Resonant_TemperStep(_Dir, _From, _To)
AND
HasActiveStatus(_Target, _From, 1)
AND
GetStatusTurns(_Target, _From, _Turns)
THEN
DB_ARCANA_Resonant_TemperPending(_Target, _From, _To, _Turns);

PROC
PROC_ARCANA_Resonant_Temper((GUIDSTRING)_Target, (STRING)_Dir, (CHARACTER)_Resonant)
AND
DB_ARCANA_Resonant_TemperPending(_Target, _From, _To, _Turns)
AND
IntegerProduct(_Turns, 6, _Secs)
AND
IntegerToReal(_Secs, _Dur)
THEN
NOT DB_ARCANA_Resonant_TemperPending(_Target, _From, _To, _Turns);
RemoveStatus(_Target, _From, _Resonant);
ApplyStatus(_Target, _To, _Dur, 1, _Resonant);
//END_REGION
EXITSECTION

ENDEXITSECTION
